parameters.help_en: The requested invoice amount, in cents
parameters.name: invoice_amount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the invoice title information, which corresponds to the ID parameter returned by the QueryInvoicingCustomerList operation
parameters.help_zh: 发票抬头信息ID，对应QueryInvoicingCustomerList接口返回的ID参数
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the mailing address, which corresponds to the ID parameter returned by the QueryCustomerAddressList operation
parameters.help_zh: 邮寄地址ID，对应QueryCustomerAddressList接口返回的ID参数
parameters.name: address_id

parameters.help_en:
The invoice type. Valid values:
0: VAT special invoice.
1: VAT general invoice
parameters.help_zh:
发票类型，取值：
0：专票
1：普票
parameters.name: invoicing_type

parameters.help_en:
The invoicing channel. Set this parameter to 1. Valid values:
0: Processed by Alibaba Cloud.
1: Processed by the tax platform
parameters.help_zh:
开票渠道，要求为1。取值示例：
0：阿里云处理
1：税务平台处理
parameters.name: process_way

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the applicant. The system does not verify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 申请人昵称，系统不做校验
parameters.name: apply_user_nick

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to issue the invoice based on a specified amount. If this parameter is set to true, the invoice is applied for based on the specified InvoiceAmount. Otherwise, the invoice is applied for based on the total amount of the selected objects to be invoiced
parameters.help_zh: 是否按金额开票，若为true则按照用户指定InvoiceAmount申请发票，否则以所选待开票对象的总金额申请发票
parameters.name: invoice_by_amount

parameters.help_en: The list of IDs of the selected objects to be invoiced, which correspond to the ID parameters returned by the QueryEvaluateList operation
parameters.help_zh: 选择开票的待开票对象ID列表，对应QueryEvaluateList接口返回的ID参数
parameters.name: selected_ids

parameters.help_en: The email addresses for receiving the invoice. The maximum length of this field is 200 characters. Separate multiple email addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 发票接收邮箱。字段长度最长200，多个邮箱可用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: emails

InvoiceApplyId.description_en: The ID of the invoice application record

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
